purpose: Remembers, for this page, which entities refused a write, and tells a screen whether it may write one.
namedChanges: `ENTITY_READ_ONLY_REASON` (line 113) is re-exported from the unit `record-write`, which holds the same sentence; there is one definition.

`entityWriteAllowed` (lines 270-276) returns record-write's `entityWriteAllowed(vaultWriteAllowed, recordId, isEntityWriteDenied(recordId))` in place of its own two-line body; same answer for every input.

`useEntityCanWrite` (line 296) calls record-write's `recordWriteAllowed(vaultWriteAllowed, record, identityKeys, isEntityWriteDenied(record.id))`; the source's own `recordWriteAllowed` read the module's `denied` itself.
A new header comment; the doc comment of `entityWriteAllowed` names `useEntityCanWrite`. The source's lines 1-82 and 115-264 (the pure half) are not taken: they are the unit `record-write`.
